intro: The technology sector anchors coverage across 78 articles on ai-security published between 2026-04-12 and 2026-10-16, with government, critical infrastructure, cybersecurity, and healthcare also represented. Claude Mythos, Midnight Blizzard, and OpenClaw appear among the top threat actors tracked, while the most severe vulnerabilities include CVE-2026-5760 at CVSS 9.8, CVE-2026-5752 at CVSS 9.3, CVE-2026-44339 at CVSS 8.6, CVE-2026-44567 at CVSS 7.7, and CVE-2026-45303 at CVSS 7.7. Reporting spans Global, United states, Australia, China, and North america. The severity mix comprises 36 high, 9 critical, 14 informational, and 6 medium items.
